lead: The one-second JWT case fails about one run in many, with `expired at N and it is now N` on the line that should verify.
body: Waiting for the second to turn before signing narrows that window without closing it, because `Core\Jwt::sign` reads the clock again itself. Re-run the case alone before believing a red conformance step; the fix is for it to assert against the `exp` the token carries rather than the second the spin saw.
